I can't check live data, and I'm not certain of the rate as of today (2026-10-03). The last level I'm confident of is 3.50-3.75%, set at the December 2025 FOMC meeting. The FOMC has met several times since then, so the target range may have changed.

For the current figure, check the Fed's FOMC page (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy) or the effective rate (EFFR) on the New York Fed's site or FRED.
